ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If the algae population declined, what would happen to the mayfly population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web. The box on the left is labeled “Leaves & Algae”, and there is an arrow pointing to the “Mayflies” box above, indicating that leaves and algae are one of the food sources of mayflies. The figure also shows that the food web continues to connect to other organisms, such as trout and humans. Reasoning: The question assumes that the amount of algae decreases. Because the figure shows that mayflies depend on leaves and algae as food, if algae decrease, the food available to mayflies will decrease, so the mayfly population usually will decline.
